shared_contracts.nextcloud-connection: nextcloud_setup exclusively owns atomic credential revisions; authorized operator confirms account resources; runtime mounts read-only; backup and restore require owner stopped
shared_contracts.setup-control: ephemeral private Unix control socket: setup-service owns, gateway may connect via read-only mount; no domain worker receives the volume
shared_contracts.core: personal_assistant.storage owns schema; sync and ActionPlan callers transact through AssistantStorage; idempotency_key is unique
shared_contracts.knowledge: personal_assistant.storage owns documents, chunks, FTS and sync cursors in a database separate from ActionPlans and audit data
shared_contracts.coordination: personal_assistant.work_scheduler owns the WAL schema; workers own only their heartbeat/log; JobController owns job_control.json; workers may enqueue bounded gateway events and only the gateway relay consumes them
shared_contracts.security: personal_assistant.antivirus owns cache schema; verdict writes are keyed by content and scanner identity
